_comment: DSpark drafter for Inkling-2-Mini (R = 3 passes, per-pass KV): trained on traces generated by the official vLLM server (training.drafter.traces_remote), with features and the last pass's distribution from the reference forward's teacher-forced run. Features per depth follow DFlash's rule along the depth's 24 layers, as for the paper's other models: the inputs of layer 2 (prelude), of layers 7, 12 and 17 in that pass, and of layer 22 in the coda on that pass's state. A block is the given token and seven masks, each predicting the token at its own position (k_max 8: eight slots, seven drafted tokens), the block of the checkpoint's bundled DSpark drafter and speculators' sample_from_anchor = false. The recipe is DSpark's as speculators implements and trains it (training.drafter.model.DSPARK): its vanilla Markov head of rank 256 and its confidence head, 0.1 CE + 0.9 TV + 1.0 confidence BCE with slot decay gamma 4 over every slot of a block, Muon (3e-3) on the 2-D weights and AdamW (6e-4, no weight decay) on the rest, cosine after 4% warmup. Depth weights, blocks per step and packing are the paper's; the 10 epochs are DSpark's. Pass --traces, --out; --target-experts packed on a 48 GB card.
